answer.reason: The verses tell of David's refuge there and of Saul's strange prophesying when he came to take him.

clauses.english: was where David found refuge with Samuel when he fled from Saul
clauses.quote: he and Samuel went and dwelt in Naioth

clauses.english: was where Saul, come to seize David, prophesied and lay naked all day and night
clauses.quote: lay down naked all that day and all that night
